__comments.RewardWhenHiderVisible: Reward per step when the Hider is visible to the Seeker (dense shaping).
__comments.RewardWhenHiderHidden: Reward per step when the Hider is not visible (can be negative to pressure exploration).
__comments.ApplyVisibilityRewardsToRL: If true, include visibility rewards in the RL training signal.
__comments.VisibilityRewardScaleRL: Scale for visibility rewards applied to RL.
__comments.VisibilityPointsScaleHUD: Scale for visibility points shown on HUD (UI only).
__comments.EnableHudVisibilityPoints: Whether to show visibility points on HUD for this role.
__comments.PointsPerSecondWhenHiderVisible: HUD points per second when Hider is visible (UI only).
__comments.PointsPerSecondWhenHiderHidden: HUD points per second when Hider is hidden (UI only).
__comments.CatchBonus: One-time reward awarded when catching the Hider.
__comments.PhysicalExploreReward: Small reward for physical exploration to avoid stagnation.
__comments.VisionAngle: Field of view angle in degrees.
__comments.RotationStepDegrees: Degrees rotated per discrete turn action.
__comments.TurnAlignFactor: How strongly the agent tries to align turning with movement direction (0..1).
__comments.AlignThresholdDegrees: Threshold in degrees to consider aligned.
__comments.Count: Number of Seeker agents spawned per episode.
__comments.RotationPenalty: Per-step penalty applied when rotating (discourages spin).
__comments.RotationPenaltyWhenFleeFactor: Scale factor for rotation penalty when fleeing.
__comments.NoProgressPenalty: Per-step penalty when no progress is detected.
__comments.ForceExploitWhenSeen: If true, force more exploitative policy once the Hider is seen.
__comments.ApplyVisibilityShapingInAgent: Apply additional visibility-based shaping in the agent logic.
__comments.EscapeBonus: Bonus if the Seeker escapes certain local traps (rare).
__comments.GainedSightBonus: Bonus when the Seeker gains sight of the Hider.
__comments.LostSightPenalty: Penalty when the Seeker loses sight of the Hider.
__comments.ProximityPenaltyNearThreshold: Distance threshold (meters) under which 'near' penalty applies.
__comments.ProximityPenaltyVeryNearThreshold: Distance threshold (meters) under which 'very near' penalty applies.
__comments.ProximityPenaltyVeryNear: Per-step penalty when within 'very near' threshold.
__comments.DoorwayCrossingBonus: Bonus when crossing a doorway (encourages room traversal).
__comments.DoorwayCenteringBonus: Bonus when crossing near doorway center (smoother navigation).
__comments.SeenByOpponentPenaltyPerStep: Penalty per step when the Seeker is visible to the Hider.
__comments.FleeDistanceRewardMultiplierWhenSeen: Multiplier for distance-increasing reward when being seen.

__comments.RewardWhenVisible: Reward per step when the Hider is visible (should be negative).
__comments.RewardWhenHidden: Reward per step when the Hider is hidden (positive to encourage hiding).
__comments.RewardWhenSeenBySeeker: Additional penalty when seen by the Seeker.
__comments.RewardWhenIncreasingDistance: Reward when increasing distance from Seeker.
__comments.RewardWhenHiddenBehindWall: Reward when line of sight is blocked by a wall.

__comments.PointsPerSecondWhenHidden: HUD points per second when hidden (UI only).
